labels.EVOLVED_FROM: Claim B is a semantic mutation of Claim A — same core assertion, different framing, emphasis, or added/dropped details. Both refer to the same real-world event.
labels.SIMILAR_TO: Claims share a topic but assert different (non-mutated) facts.
labels.UNRELATED: Claims are about different events or topics.
labels.DUPLICATE: Claims are semantically identical or near-identical.
